summary:
An English market-town chandlery. Facing the street is a red-brick shop storey with a projecting candle-filled bay window and a separate family door. Above it is a jettied dark-oak and calcite half-timbered storey under a 45° slate gable with two dormers and an east-gable chimney. Behind it are a brick workshop with its own tall rendering-hearth chimney, an open drying lean-to for the candle racks, and a beehive garden that supplies the wax, so the street front reads as a shop, house and workshop all at once. English market-town chandlery: red-brick ground storey on a stone plinth with a five-wide candle bay, a jettied dark-oak/calcite upper storey under a 45° slate roof with two dormers, and a brick east chimney.
Behind it stand a brick workshop with a signal-fire rendering chimney, an open drying lean-to with candle racks, and a back garden of beehives behind a picket fence.
Six trade-cut parts; seven rooms; elements.md and the plan.md sections are written.

rooms.name: Shop
rooms.purpose: The candle shop: warm, crowded and fragrant. Focal piece is a counter of dark_oak_planks with slab top near the back, candle shelves (trapdoors, slabs, honeycomb_block accents, lit candle clusters) on the west and south walls, and the bay display on the sill shelf. Floor spruce_planks.
rooms.ways_in: Shop door (7,2..3,8) from the street; doorway (10,2..3,17) to the workshop; partition opening (12,2..3,10) to the family hall. The bay [10,2,7,12,4,8] opens into it.

rooms.name: Family hall and kitchen
rooms.purpose: The family's living room and kitchen. Focal piece is the brick hearth at the east wall, with a table and benches in the middle. The stair along x=16 and a cosy, lit mood. Floor oak_planks.
rooms.ways_in: Family door (15,2..3,8); opening (12,2..3,10) from the shop; back door (16,2..3,17) to the lean-to; stair at x=16, z=13..16 up.

rooms.name: Chandler's workshop
rooms.purpose: The dipping and moulding room, hot and dim, open to the rafters. Focal piece is the rendering hearth at the south with a lit campfire and a tallow cauldron in front. Cauldron dipping vats and a dipping wheel (fence post with chains and candles) in the middle, a moulding bench and barrels along the walls. Floor stone_bricks.
rooms.ways_in: Doorway (10,2..3,17) from the shop; spruce side door (13,2..3,21) to the lean-to.

rooms.name: Drying lean-to
rooms.purpose: Open timber shed where candles cure: racks of dark-oak fence uprights with trapdoor shelves holding white_candle clusters, tallow barrels at the back, a lantern. Floor podzol and coarse_dirt.
rooms.ways_in: Back door (16,2..3,17) from the hall; side door (13,2..3,21) from the workshop; open on the east and south to the yard.

rooms.name: Parlour
rooms.purpose: The family's best room, over the shop. Warm and book-lined, lit by the paired front windows and the dormers. Focal piece is a lectern with bookshelves, a settle under the windows and a rug. Open to the roof beams. Floor dark_oak_planks.
rooms.ways_in: The stair head at (16,7,12) from the stair at x=16; doorways (8,7..8,13) and (13,7..8,13) to the bedchambers.

rooms.name: West bedchamber
rooms.purpose: Small, quiet bedroom: a bed against the west wall, a chest, a lantern and a candle on a shelf.

rooms.name: East bedchamber
rooms.purpose: Small bedroom over the hall: a bed, a chest, a window to the east. A fence rail at x=15 guards the stairwell.

concept_subject: A candle maker's home and shop in an English market town, its eaves to a cobbled street (the street is to the north). The main house is 13 blocks wide on a grey stone-brick plinth. Its ground storey is warm red brick with long-and-short stone quoins. In the middle a five-wide shop bay window stands one block out: dark-oak posts, three panes glowing with clusters of yellow and white candles, and a dark-oak fascia board carrying a sign. A dark-oak shop door with a glazed transom stands to its left and a separate family door with a little stone hood to its right. Over this the upper storey juts out one block on upside-down dark-oak brackets. It is half-timbered: near-black dark-oak posts and beams over off-white calcite daub, a pair of windows above the bay, and diagonal braces in the outer panels. It sits under a 45° grey slate roof with dark-oak verges, a slab ridge and two small gabled dormers facing the street. A red-brick chimney stack with a dark band and a smoking cap climbs the east gable end. A dark-oak bracket at the west corner holds a hanging sign with a lit three-candle cluster on its tip. Behind the house runs a lower, single-storey brick workshop under its own slate gable, with a second tall brick chimney at its back gable sending up a tall plume of smoke from the tallow-rendering hearth. Against its east side is an open dark-oak lean-to sheltering racks of drying candles and tallow barrels. A spruce picket fence closes a back garden with a row of four beehives and a bright flower bed, a woodpile by the chimney, barrels and a cauldron by the gate, an apple tree and a dirt path from the side gate.
concept_size: 26 wide, 34 deep (house 13 x 11, workshop 9 x 10 behind), 2 storeys plus a 45° roof, ridge at 16 and chimney to 19 blocks
